dim-01-c1.text: Bureau International des Poids et Mesures (BIPM) (2019). Measurement units. BIPM.
dim-01-c1.quote: Since 20 May 2019, all SI units have been defined by fixing the numerical values of seven defining constants.
dim-01-c1.claim: Since 2019, all seven have been defined by fixing exact numerical values of fundamental constants
